plannedDeployment.content:
apiVersion: v1
automountServiceAccountToken: false
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  labels:
    llm-d.ai/accelerator-variant: xpu
    llm-d.ai/accelerator-vendor: intel
    llm-d.ai/guide: optimized-baseline
    llm-d.ai/model: Qwen3-0.6B
  name: optimized-baseline-xpu-vllm-sa
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  labels:
    llm-d.ai/accelerator-variant: xpu
    llm-d.ai/accelerator-vendor: intel
    llm-d.ai/guide: optimized-baseline
    llm-d.ai/model: Qwen3-0.6B
    llm-d.ai/role: decode
  name: optimized-baseline-xpu-vllm-decode
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      llm-d.ai/accelerator-variant: xpu
      llm-d.ai/accelerator-vendor: intel
      llm-d.ai/guide: optimized-baseline
      llm-d.ai/model: Qwen3-0.6B
      llm-d.ai/role: decode
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        llm-d.ai/accelerator-variant: xpu
        llm-d.ai/accelerator-vendor: intel
        llm-d.ai/guide: optimized-baseline
        llm-d.ai/model: Qwen3-0.6B
        llm-d.ai/role: decode
    spec:
      containers:
      - args:
        - Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B
        - --port=8000
        - --dtype=float16
        - --disable-sliding-window
        - --disable-access-log-for-endpoints=/health,/metrics,/v1/models
        - --shutdown-timeout=45
        - --tensor-parallel-size=1
        command:
        - vllm
        - serve
        env:
        - name: HF_TOKEN
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              key: HF_TOKEN
              name: llm-d-hf-token
              optional: true
        - name: HTTP_PROXY
          value: http://proxy-ir.intel.com:912
        - name: HTTPS_PROXY
          value: http://proxy-ir.intel.com:912
        - name: NO_PROXY
          value: localhost,127.0.0.1,10.112.228.229,10.112.104.73,10.112.110.115,10.112.0.0/16,192.168.1.10,192.168.1.11,192.168.1.12,192.168.1.13,192.168.239.0/24,192.168.240.0/20,10.233.0.0/18,10.233.64.0/18,svc,svc.cluster.local,10.112.229.74,10.112.110.140
        image: ghcr.io/llm-d/llm-d-xpu:v1.0.0
        lifecycle:
          preStop:
            exec:
              command:
              - /bin/sleep
              - '15'
        livenessProbe:
          failureThreshold: 3
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: modelserver
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
        name: modelserver
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8000
          name: modelserver
          protocol: TCP
        readinessProbe:
          failureThreshold: 3
          httpGet:
            path: /v1/models
            port: modelserver
          periodSeconds: 5
          timeoutSeconds: 2
        resources:
          claims:
          - name: intel-decode-claim
          limits:
            cpu: '8'
            memory: 24Gi
          requests:
            cpu: '4'
            memory: 12Gi
        startupProbe:
          failureThreshold: 120
          httpGet:
            path: /v1/models
            port: modelserver
          initialDelaySeconds: 15
          periodSeconds: 30
          timeoutSeconds: 5
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /.cache
          name: torch-compile-cache
        - mountPath: /.triton
          name: triton-cache
        - mountPath: /.config
          name: vllm-config
      resourceClaims:
      - name: intel-decode-claim
        resourceClaimTemplateName: optimized-baseline-xpu-vllm-intel-claim-template-decode
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 107
        supplementalGroups:
        - 107
      serviceAccountName: optimized-baseline-xpu-vllm-sa
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 75
      volumes:
      - emptyDir: {}
        name: torch-compile-cache
      - emptyDir: {}
        name: triton-cache
      - emptyDir: {}
        name: vllm-config
      nodeSelector:
        intel.feature.node.kubernetes.io/gpu: 'true'
  progressDeadlineSeconds: 1800
---
apiVersion: resource.k8s.io/v1
kind: ResourceClaimTemplate
metadata:
  labels:
    llm-d.ai/role: decode
  name: optimized-baseline-xpu-vllm-intel-claim-template-decode
spec:
  spec:
    devices:
      requests:
      - exactly:
          count: 1
          deviceClassName: gpu.intel.com
        name: intel
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: optimized-baseline-modelserver
  labels:
    llm-d.ai/guide: optimized-baseline
spec:
  selector:
    llm-d.ai/accelerator-variant: xpu
    llm-d.ai/accelerator-vendor: intel
    llm-d.ai/guide: optimized-baseline
    llm-d.ai/model: Qwen3-0.6B
    llm-d.ai/role: decode
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 8000
    targetPort: modelserver

warnings: Accelerator memory was not reported by DRA; using the known 24 GiB capacity for B60.
